description: Run JavaScript in the page. Good uses: computation, style mutations (.style.X = ..., classList), shadow-root traversal, in-page fetch(), app-specific side effects no dedicated tool covers. Scope is shared between calls; top-level const/let/class are wrapped in an IIFE. If/else blocks may return undefined — use a ternary or an explicit return.

expression.description: JavaScript code to execute in the page context

name: evaluate
